subject: Document coordination conflict on the Section 08 71 00 interior door hardware set at the

messages.text: Shop drawings for the Section 08 71 00 interior door hardware set at the stair enclosure are ready to submit, but what's shown doesn't match what's built out in the field mockup -- can you confirm which governs? We would like this closed out ahead of the next submittal deadline. No cost impact is anticipated. No schedule impact is expected. There is no specific deadline for this, but a timely response is appreciated.
